name: LiquidAI — Agentic Treasury OS
description: LiquidAI transforms idle stablecoin balances into autonomous yield with instant liquidity for real-world payments.
problemStatement: MiniPay users in emerging markets hold stablecoins that stay idle and lose purchasing power over time. LiquidAI solves the capital-efficiency gap with an AI treasury agent that keeps spend liquidity while allocating idle funds to yield routes.
